# InVet Command: plan-task

Equivalent to OpenCode `/plan-task`.

Input: `BE-00X`, `FE-00X`, or `QA-00X`.

Use agent: `InVet Product Planner`.

Read only the planning sources and template required by `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. Create or repair the canonical schema v3 plan and required `US/UIA/APIA` artifacts. Generate and verify all five manifests. Do not implement source code or delegate.
Use the 7-column traceability matrix with `Estado` as required by the plan template.
